name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based digital audio workstation built in Rust and WebAssembly: multitrack editing, a mixer with inserts, sends and automation, MIDI and a piano roll, and bouncing to audio files.

alerts.message: Sessions and audio are not stored on the server: the DAW runs in the browser, opens files from your device and saves or exports them as downloads. The web build cannot record audio.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the source of the official release tags.
